items.name: CLIPPER_SOFTNESS_PCT_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/clipper.json at 347ae7990821, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_clipper_instance.h#so

items.doc: How far under the ceiling the bend starts, percent of CLIPPER_KNEE_SPAN of the ceiling. 0 is a hard clip. Above the knee a sample bends along a hyperbola that leaves the straight line at slope 1 and never reaches the ceiling.

items.name: CLIPPER_KNEE_SPAN

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/clipper.json at 347ae7990821, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_clipper_instance.h#omx_clipper_instance_resolve

items.doc: The share of the ceiling the bend spans at a softness of 100 %: the knee sits at (1 - span x softness) x ceiling, half the ceiling at full softness, 6 dB under it.
